title: OpenDEA Compatibility Metadata
description: Explicit compatibility declaration for a model version. SemVer alone is insufficient — adding a question can change the statistical interpretation of a score (CR-AM-01 §25).

backward_compatible.description: Existing results from previous_version can still be processed without change.

scoring_compatible.description: Scores from previous_version have the same interpretation.

maturity_compatible.description: Results from previous_version can be mapped to the same maturity interpretation.

benchmark_compatible.description: Results from previous_version may legitimately participate in cross-organisation benchmarking with this version.

result_compatible.description: Result structure is unchanged; results can flow through unchanged downstream.
